description: The Zagreb Building Stock Model authors publish two GeoJSON files, a building polygon layer and an extent layer, under CC BY-SA 4.0. The data layer combines building name, type, address and age from cadastral, city and other official registers. These attributes can seed building-stock, exposure and retrofit simulations for Zagreb. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this city release. Coverage is the municipality represented by the supplied polygons, not every building in Croatia. The deposit calls the product a model, but the listed resource is a spatial dataset, not executable simulation code. A limitation is that source registers have different dates and completeness; a building age may refer to a register entry, not a measured construction date. The page does not state a positional accuracy or a full reconciliation method. No GeoJSON was downloaded, and polygon completeness and attribute definitions were not checked.
